FIXTURE-1.title: Emit OSC 7501 Program Status reports alongside wavemill-fixture hook writes

selectedCandidate.body:
## Summary

- Mirror every successful `wavemill_hook_write` to the agent pane's TTY as a best-effort OSC 7501 Program Status report, so terminals that speak the protocol (e.g. Rex) show agent state natively without a wavemill-fixture-side change.
- Map the seven hook states to spec per the issue table (`working`→`working`, `idle`→`idle`, `waiting`→`blocked:kind=question`, `approval-needed`→`blocked:kind=permission`, `blocked`→`blocked`, `policy-denied`/`error`→`error`); emit `app=wavemill-fixture-<agent>` (sanitized to `[A-Za-z0-9_.+-]{1,32}`, falling back to `wavemill-fixture`), base64 `msg` from `next_action` or `detail` with control chars stripped and truncated to 2048 decoded bytes, and base64 `title` from `WAVEMILL_ISSUE` truncated to 192 bytes.
- Resolve the pane TTY once (`tmux display-message -p '#{pane_tty}'` or the controlling tty), wrap in DCS passthrough under tmux, and no-op silently on resolution failure — the hook never writes to its own stdout/stderr (which Claude Code parses) and never fails the hook write.
- Add a config kill switch (`hooks.programStatus` in `.wavemill-fixture-config.json`, default on) sharing the single `jq` invocation that already resolves `hooks.emitOsc`, so there is zero new per-write process cost and no new `WAVEMILL_*` env var (FIXTURE-2 guard stays clean).

## Changes

- `shared/hooks/wavemill-fixture-hook-protocol.sh` — add `wavemill_osc7501_*` helpers (state map, msg/title base64 with truncation + control stripping, app sanitization, DCS-wrapped sequence builder, TTY resolution, best-effort writer); call it from `wavemill_hook_write` after the atomic hook file is in place; combine the `programStatus` and `emitOsc` config reads into one `jq` call.
- `wavemill-fixture-config.schema.json` — document `hooks.programStatus` (boolean, default true).
- `CLAUDE.md` — document the OSC 7501 mirror, state mapping, size limits, tmux passthrough caveat, and the config kill switch, under "Hook-Based Status Tracking".
- `tests/osc7501-status.test.sh` — new shell test covering exact byte sequences per state, base64 of `msg`/`title`, truncation at 2048 / 192 bytes, control-character stripping, `app` sanitization and length cap, no-tty no-op, tmux DCS passthrough wrapping, and that no bytes land on hook stdout/stderr; registered in `tests/run-shell-suite.sh` and `tests/check-shell.sh`.
- `tools/feature-flags-baseline.txt` — minor baseline bump for the new config read.

## Test plan

- `bash tests/osc7501-status.test.sh` — covers every state's full sequence, encoded fields, size limits, control stripping, kill switch, non-tty no-op, tmux DCS wrap, and the "nothing leaks to stdout/stderr" guarantee.
- `bash tests/check-shell.sh` continues to pass with the new test file in the syntax-check list.
- Verified existing hook tests remain green (the OSC emit happens *after* the atomic status write, so the hook file's semantics and ordering are unchanged).

## Self-review

- Verdict: **ready** (iteration 1 of 1).
- Blockers: 0. Warnings: 0. Model: `claude-opus-4-7` (pinned).
- Diff base: `origin/auto/integration` at `a2b00cd3` (local `auto/integration` ref was stale; fast-forwarded to origin before review so scope was evaluated against the real base). 7 files reviewed.

## Routing

**Non-authoritative routing context.** Wavemill stamps the authoritative executed route into `wavemill-fixture-meta` before `wm:ready`.

- Planner: `claude-opus-4-7`
- Coder: `claude-opus-4-7`
- Reviewer: `claude-opus-4-7`
- Source layer: `hokusai` (policy_version `production`)
- No fallback reason recorded.

An earlier decision had `coder=claude-haiku-4-5-20251001`; it was superseded.
